'''2010 US West Nationals Day 1 UCSBYoda LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[UCSBYoda]] at [[2010 US West Nationals]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassithroneroom.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Shannon!
* '''Deck name:''' Aaron Nelson I wish you were here
* '''Username:''' UCSBYoda
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
